purpose: Stop repeated whole-wave expansion and move efficiently into V5 discovery model development while preserving hard lineage checks, local matched pairs, nuisance baselines, and a sealed CONFIRM holdout.
why_amended: After Original DEV + E1 + E2 collection, PROJECT negative outcomes remain structurally sparse under the frozen discrete-project definition.
Repeated whole-wave expansion is now low-yield and risks optimizing the research process around a coverage artifact rather than the production objective.
Chronology, age, and collection-wave structure can be measured explicitly as nuisance baselines rather than requiring the discovery corpus to be perfectly nuisance-neutral before modeling.

data_rules.E2_primary_model_subset: research-eligible rows with source_quality=high and without explicitly fuzzy semantic event types
data_rules.E2_broad_sensitivity_subset: research-eligible rows with source_quality in {high, medium}
data_rules.collapse_reason: Multiple events in the same subject-year share the same annual astrology state; collapsing prevents pseudo-replication.

pairing.pair_row_unit: unique subject-axis earlier_year-later_year polarity contrast after subject-year-polarity collapse

nuisance_strategy.instead: Record grouped-CV nuisance performance and require astrology candidates to show incremental out-of-sample lift over nuisance baselines.

discovery_model_constraints.axis_specific_astrology_interactions: forbidden initially because PROJECT is underpowered

hard_blockers_that_remain: axis mismatch between event and frozen roster
invalid polarity/year in a retained model event
fewer than 30 pairable subjects overall in PRIMARY_TRUSTED
only one target class after pairing
next_if_pass: Generate astrology primitives only for frozen paired subject-years; run shared-coefficient V5 discovery tournament against nuisance-only baselines; freeze candidate architecture before opening/researching CONFIRM.
